Subject: Intro: VP Eng / CTO alignment - Redwood Inference

Thanks again for your time earlier today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- Key context: Aperture is evaluating inference performance and cost across models for a multi-product rollout in H1. Primary constraints: sub-200ms p95 latency for critical paths, and auditability for data retention.
- Wanted: a technical deep dive (demo + infra Qs) with your VP Eng/CTO to validate architecture fit and timelines.
- Internal ask: bring our Solutions Engineer (Rachel) for the demo and our sales lead (Vivek) for commercial/exec alignment.

Next steps / scheduling: can we schedule a 45-minute alignment between VP Eng + CTO + your product/infra lead and our CTO-aligned SE + sales lead? Proposed windows (all PST):
  - Tue Dec 1, 10:00–10:45am
  - Wed Dec 2, 3:00–3:45pm

I've attached the discovery notes (summary) and added a short mutual action plan below. If either slot works, I'll send a calendar invite + agenda.

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 0: Exec alignment call (VP/CTO) — confirm architecture fit and required security docs.
- Week 1: Technical deep dive & demo with SE.
- Week 2: Procurement kickoff / SOW draft if fit.

Attachments: discovery-notes.docx

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

- Dec 1, 10am PST — preferred
- Dec 2, 3pm PST — backup

Attendees on our side likely: myself (VP Eng), Carlos Mendes (CTO), and our infra lead (TBD) — I'll confirm exact names by Friday. Procurement is copied for awareness.

Great — Dec 1 at 10am PST is locked from our side. Sending a calendar invite now (45 min). I've attached a short architecture diagram and a proposed 45-minute agenda.

Proposed agenda (45m):
- 0–10m: Intros & high-level goals (Marissa / Anita)
- 10–30m: Technical deep dive + demo highlights (Rachel) — focus on latency, caching, and fallbacks
- 30–40m: Sizing & deployment options (Vivek + Rachel)
- 40–45m: Next steps & mutual action items (all)

Mutual action items (updated):
1) Redwood: provide SOC2 snapshot, architecture diagram, and demo environment notes (by EOD Mon Nov 30).
2) Aperture: confirm infra lead and any network constraints; share any procurement timelines.
3) Schedule technical deep dive follow-up week of Dec 7 if alignment looks good.

Attachments: redwood-architecture-diagram.png
Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/marissa/15m?slot=20261201T10:00
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/APTR-2026-11

Subject: Re: Intro: VP Eng / CTO alignment - Redwood Inference

Hi Anita / Marissa — thanks for including me. A couple quick Qs to make the 30m technical portion productive:

- Which workload(s) should I demo? (inference for search vs. chat vs. embeddings)
- Typical sequence length and target qps for the critical path? Any sample p95 targets beyond the <200ms callout?
- Do you prefer a hosted demo or a short walkthrough of a customer-like deployment we can spin up?

I'll prepare a concise demo focusing on prefix/KV caching and our routing/fallback policy (these directly impact p95 and unit cost). Attached is a one-page proposed tech agenda. If you can share the above details before Nov 30, I can tailor the demo.

Attachments: tech-deep-dive-agenda.pdf

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Confirmed for Dec 1, 10:00–10:45am PST. Attendees: Anita Shah (VP Eng), Carlos Mendes (CTO), Priya N. (Infra Lead), and procurement. Looking forward to Rachel's demo — please focus on chat inference and caching behavior; our critical path is chat with average seq len ~150 tokens and peak qps ~35.

Procurement asked for a SOC2 snapshot and a short list of standard contract terms you typically include (we can redline after the call). I've attached a quick checklist of items procurement expects.

See you shortly.
